question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a white ball, and Claire has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Claire and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) white ball
(C) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (green, white, brown)
1. Swap Claire and Alice: (brown, white, green)
2. Swap Bob and Claire: (brown, green, white)
3. Swap Claire and Bob: (brown, white, green)
Alice has the brown ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
